_help: Landscape style references for the inspiration gallery. These are illustrations, not completed projects. When you add real project photos, set 'kind' to 'project', add a 'photo' object, and only describe work you actually did. Never label third-party or AI-generated images as your projects.

items.title: Modern tropical
items.description: Architectural foliage against clean walls, with strong shapes and plenty of breathing room.

items.title: Classic & timeless
items.description: Balanced beds, soft rounded hedges and a welcoming path to the door.

items.title: Natural Florida
items.description: Native plants arranged with care. Water-wise, wildlife-friendly and at home in the local landscape.

items.title: Minimal & contemporary
items.description: A few well-chosen plants, clean gravel and simple lines. Calm, uncluttered and easy to live with.

items.title: Colorful tropical garden
items.description: Layered foliage in reds, golds and greens, with flowers that bring in butterflies and hummingbirds.

items.title: Small-space transformations
items.description: Entryways, courtyards and side yards where every plant and planter counts.
